0.original: The Crystal Exarch is finally ready to discuss the matter of your comrades' whereabouts.

28.original: Speak with the manager of suites in the Pendants.

29.original: Speak with the Crystal Exarch in the Ocular.

48.original: I've been keeping that device you uncovered safe and sound. Did you need to use it again...?

49.original: Touch the beacon and travel to the First?

50.original: You've done as I requested, and learned something of the world in which you find yourself. Now it's time I fulfilled my half of the bargain, and explained what has befallen your comrades.

51.original: That is a conversation I would rather have in the privacy of my quarters, however. I must go on ahead to the tower and organize a few things, but I shall see that the guard knows to admit you.

53.original: The tower's gate lies open, then?

54.original: Just like that? Then...G'raha Tia is...?

55.original: Well, yes, of course. It can be opened and closed just like any other. Does that seem strange to you?

56.original: I know not how the tower functioned in your time, but I assure you there is no danger of us being locked inside.

57.original: ...I am not familiar with that name. Is there something I should know?

58.original: An extraordinary tale. But I'm afraid I found no such individual residing in the tower when it passed into my care. Mayhap we can revisit that mystery another time. For now, I think it best that we focus on the present.

59.original: Greetings, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. The Exarch awaits you within.

61.original: Touring the city with the Exarch, are you? You could have no finer guide!

62.original: The Crystarium boasts a number of residential districts, but I have been informed that a room has just become available at the Pendants.

63.original: Which, as it turns out, is perfect. Our path there will take us past the markets, and I was hoping to give you my own introduction to their wares. Come along.

64.original: As a result of your pact with Feo Ul, you now have access to delivery moogles, market boards, and summoning bells while in the First.

65.original: Welcome to the Pendants, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You're here with the Exarch...?

66.original: Ah, there you are─I was just finalizing the matter of your accommodation. You'll have a private room here at the Pendants for the duration of your stay, to make use of as you see fit.

67.original: When you are ready to retire, the manager will show you to your lodgings. Pray rest and recuperate, and we shall reconvene in the Ocular anon.

68.original: I believe that covers all of the practical concerns...

69.original: ...Thank you for answering my call, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We are denied the comforting blanket of night, but may peaceful dreams attend you nonetheless.

70.original: A pleasure to meet you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, and welcome to your new home at the Pendants.

71.original: Your room is ready, if you'd care to retire?
